_comment: Tind AI box providers. Shown as 'name - country'; models as 'name (use)', use one of quick, everyday, coding. 'default' is preselected for a new chat. 'service' says which system user talks to the model: 'remote' (tind-ai-remote, one host only) or 'local' (tind-ai-local, no network; for a model on this computer). Model ids can be changed per user in the window; these are the suggestions.
